_note: Source: /workspace/tradersfundhub/research/closed-firms-evidence.md (captured 2026-10-20). Only firms that file recommends are listed. status, dateLabel, quote and each reported[] item carry sourceType: 'primary' (firm, regulator or court) or 'secondary' (trade press only; must set reportedBy). Secondary items render as 'Reported by <source>' with a link, never as fact. Keep 'published' false until editorial sign-off; while false the page is noindex and left out of the sitemap.

firms.name: True Forex Funds

dateLabel.text: Notice live by May 13, 2024 (the notice itself is undated)

quote.text: We regret to inform you that True Forex Funds has ceased all operations and will be closing permanently due to financial insolvency.

firms.note: The firm's own site still showed the notice on October 20, 2026.

firms.name: Funded Engineer

status.text: Closed (said it would file for bankruptcy)

dateLabel.text: Notice live by July 19, 2024 (the notice itself is undated)

quote.text: It is with deep regret and a heavy heart that we announce the permanent closure of Funded Engineer.

firms.note: The live domain is now parked; the archived copy shows the notice. We found no bankruptcy filing.

firms.name: SurgeTrader

quote.text: It is with deep regret that we announce that as of today, Friday, May 24, 2024, SurgeTrader has closed and ceased all operations.

firms.note: No archived copy of SurgeTrader's own notice exists. SurgeTrader's own X post that day is a bare link, so the status, date and wording above rest on FX News Group's report.

firms.name: MyFundedFX

quote.text: Only the Prop arm of the operations is closing, the CFD Brokerage remains open.

reported.text: Rebranded from MyFundedFX to SeacrestFunded around February 11, 2025.

firms.note: myfundedfx.com now redirects to seacrestmarkets.io/closed, which says Seacrest Markets is no longer operating (undated). MyFundedFutures is a separate brand and is still operating.

firms.name: The Funded Trader

status.text: Offline since September–October 2026, no official statement

dateLabel.text: Sites returning HTTP 402 since at least October 14, 2026

firms.note: That quote is the error both official domains returned on October 20, 2026. The firm has not said it is closed; the last archived copy (June 2026) shows it still selling challenges. We delisted it on October 14, 2026.
